description: Figure 5(a) displays training loss curves for various model configurations during training from scratch, with the y-axis representing the loss value (scaled from 94 to 100) and the x-axis representing the number of training steps (ranging from 0 to approximately 143,000). The plot includes five distinct lines, each corresponding to a different method: Vanilla (purple dashed line), SepLLM (n=64) (orange solid line), SepLLM (n=128) (blue dashed line), SepLLM (n=64, H) (green solid line), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T) (red dashed line). All lines begin at a loss value of approximately 99.5 and show a general downward trend over time, indicating decreasing loss. The Vanilla model starts with the highest loss and decreases slowly, while the SepLLM variants show faster initial decreases. The SepLLM (n=64, H/T) model exhibits the steepest decline initially, reaching a loss value of approximately 95.5 at around 10,000 steps, followed by a plateau. The SepLLM (n=64, H) model follows a similar trajectory but remains slightly above the H/T variant. The SepLLM (n=128) model shows a slower decrease compared to the n=64 variants. The SepLLM (n=64) model starts with a loss value of approximately 99.5 and decreases to around 96.5 by the end of training.
